text:
maria_g: Quick sync  final push for webinar next Thu. We need: X thread (3 posts staggered), LinkedIn carousel (4 cards), a 20s highlight clip, and a short PM template for inbound leads. Who picks what? :rocket:

leo_s: I can own carousel + clip thumbnail. Please drop final headline + three CTAs by Tue noon. I'll export 1200x1200 & 1200x630 and a vertical cut for stories.

arun_p: I'll handle benchmark copy + lead routing. Plan: registrants -> 4q qualifier -> score>=8 -> SDR-high-priority; else nurture drip. CTA: short.redwood.ai/qualify.

jess_p: I'll take comment ops + PM template for 72hrs post. Suggest we stagger X posts 10/10 mins, then push LinkedIn 8 mins after final X post. Also recommend a $350 boost on the stat post.

figma-design: Figma file updated: https://www.figma.com/file/uniqueid/webinar-pack 9 comps for carousel + clip frames. Added safe-area notes and dark-mode variants.

arun_p: Quick UTM snippet for runbook: `?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_oct2026` — will append to qualifier + recording links.

maria_g: Good. Arun  can you A/B two stat lines? Put stat A in X post 2 and stat B in carousel card 2.

arun_p: Yep. Stat A: "p95 inference latency down 43%". Stat B: "unit cost per request down 31%". I'll prepare both short blurbs.

leo_s: Micro-ask: need exact max headline length for clip thumb (<=45 chars) and 1-line CTAs for carousel.

maria_g: Headline: "Predictable inference. Clear economics." CTAs (3): "See the benchmark", "Reserve your seat", "Get a demo".

jess_p: PM template draft: "Thanks for registering! Can you share one-sentence about your LLM use case? Reply 'demo' to request a walkthrough." I'll also prepare 6 canned replies for pricing, on-prem, dedicated, integrations, benchmarks, and recordings.

sam-bot: Proposed schedule queued: `Thu 15:00 UTC: X post 1 (teaser)`; `Thu 15:10 UTC: X post 2 (stat + CTA)`; `Thu 15:20 UTC: X post 3 (last call)`; `Thu 15:28 UTC: LinkedIn carousel`. Confirm timings.

maria_g: Confirmed. Jess  can you own comment follow-ups for first 48h?

jess_p: Yep. I'll batch replies every hour and escalate demo requests to growth ops.

arun_p: Adding routing rule to Growth runbook: ``if qualifier.score>=8 then assign=SDR-high priority; tag=webinar_oct2026; source=social_x``. Also adding UTM mapping to `runbook/social/webinar_oct2026.md`.

leo_s: I'll export assets Tue EOD and drop final PNGs + mp4 in the shared folder. Also will include a transparent thumbnail and 16:9 burn-in subtitle version.

maria_g: Solid. One last thing  can someone drop the first X post one-liner so I can approve tone?

arun_p: "Curious how infra changes LLM economics? Join our 45-min webinar to see real numbers -> short.redwood.ai/qualify"

maria_g: Nice. Tweak: replace 'infra' with 'inference infra' and add 'measurable'. Updated: "Curious how inference infra changes LLM economics? Join our 45-min webinar to see measurable numbers -> short.redwood.ai/qualify"

jess_p: Approved for tone. I'll slot reply pins and the pinned FAQ (links to qualifier, recording, docs).

sam-bot: Reminder set: review final drafts 30m before first post. I'll auto-publish if drafts are approved.

maria_g: Checklist: leo exports (Tue EOD)  arun stats + routing (Mon EOD)  jess replies + PM script (Wed EOD). If anything slips, flag here and we'll move the schedule one day. :white_check_mark:

leo_s: Noted. Will ping when assets uploaded.

arun_p: Done on my side after I get legal clearance for using a short customer quote on card 2. Pinged legal.

maria_g: Thanks team  lock visible once drafts are in the queue. :eyes:
